practice_units.title: Observing Shadow Formation
practice_units.problem: Explain what happens to the size of a shadow when you move an object closer to a light source.
guidance: Set up a stationary light source (like a torch) and a screen.
Place an opaque object between the light source and the screen.
Slowly move the object towards the light source.
Observe the changes in the shadow's size on the screen.
practice_units.solution: As the object moves closer to the light source, it blocks a larger area of light, causing the shadow to become larger on the screen.

practice_units.title: Reflection from a Plane Mirror
practice_units.problem: Determine the characteristics of an image formed by a plane mirror.
guidance: Place a small object in front of a plane mirror.
Check if the image is upright or inverted.
Compare the size of the image with the size of the object.
Check the distance of the image from the mirror compared to the object's distance.
practice_units.solution: The image formed by a plane mirror is virtual, upright, of the same size as the object, and at the same distance behind the mirror as the object is in front of it.
